# Website Traffic Dashboard Plan

A simple dashboard for a non-technical audience should focus on **trend, change, and context**. With only six months of data, the best goal is to make traffic movement easy to understand at a glance.

## Recommended Charts

| Chart | What it should show | Why it helps |
|---|---|---|
| Line chart | Monthly visits from Jan to Jun | Best for showing the overall traffic trend over time |
| Column chart | Visits by month side by side | Makes month-to-month comparisons very easy to read |
| Month-over-month change chart | Increase or decrease in visits compared with the prior month | Highlights growth moments and dips clearly |

## Dashboard Content Plan

### 1) Line Chart: Traffic Trend Over Time
- Show months on the x-axis and visits on the y-axis.
- Use a single line with markers for each month.
- Add a simple label for the peak month, **June: 2,100 visits**.

### 2) Column Chart: Monthly Volume Comparison
- Show one bar per month.
- Keep the bars in chronological order.
- This helps a non-technical audience quickly see that traffic rose after March and peaked in June.

### 3) Change Chart: Month-over-Month Movement
- Show the difference from one month to the next.
- Use green bars for increases and red bars for declines.
- This makes it easy to spot the biggest jump, which appears to be **March to April**.

## Key Insights and Questions

- **Is traffic generally growing?**
  Yes. Visits rise from **1,200 in January** to **2,100 in June**.

- **When did growth accelerate?**
  The strongest upward shift appears between **March and April**.

- **Was there any dip before the rise?**
  Yes. Traffic fell slightly from **February to March** before climbing again.

- **Which month performed best?**
  **June** has the highest traffic in this dataset.

- **Is the growth steady or uneven?**
  Growth is uneven early on, then becomes stronger in the last three months.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build dashboard] https://www.canva.com/
Action: [Button: Create chart] https://www.google.com/sheets/about/
Action: [Button: Track traffic] https://analytics.google.com/

## Sources

- Chart design guidance: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/data-visualization/
- Google Sheets charts: https://support.google.com/docs/topic/1361471
- Google Analytics: https://analytics.google.com/
